lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters; the mid-flank region displays a semi-regular grid of approximately 15-20 prominent centroids between the pectoral and dorsal fins, with inter-centroid distance increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a lattice; high-luminance blobs are centered precisely at these nodal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge is visible along the mid-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing slope and low-intensity pixels on the ventral-facing slope.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense constellation of significantly smaller, high-frequency white spots is visible on the rostrum and dorsal surface of the head, contrasting with the larger, more sparse patterning on the flank.
